scope: ZE-11-REWORK; measured mobile performance and bounded Google recovery, no ZE-12 or deployment

findings.finding: Cold mobile transfer and eager React/motion/editorial rendering delayed hero
findings.correction: Pre-render actual hero DOM/CSS, native bootstrap with hydration handoff, supported chunk boundaries and lazy editorial demand

findings.finding: Full showroom, excessive logo/favicon transfer and competing font weights during mobile intro
findings.correction: Exact portrait crop, AVIF picture/preload and WebP fallback, responsive transparent logo, 64px favicon and deferred editorial/font weights

findings.finding: Mobile arrival timing keeps the car visually incomplete after assets load
findings.correction: Natural mobile-only fade now1.0s+.15s, same easing/scale/position; desktop unchanged; all other intro layers/session retained

findings.finding: Previous uncompressed local transport differs from native Pages Brotli
findings.correction: Rebuild baseline6bdd370 and measure baseline/candidate native Pages with identical normal-motion cold profile; do not claim compression as code gain

findings.finding: Artwork404 can complete before React event handlers exist; direct native fallback DOM mutation then mismatches hydration
findings.correction: Native fallback records artwork state and initial React tree adopts matching fallback source/children; reflection shares source; bootstrap header lookup safe

findings.finding: Failed lazy editorial chunk reached boundary but duplicate imperative import produced unhandled rejection
findings.correction: Remove duplicate imperative readiness import; actual child commit callback marks readiness, while React.lazy owns failures and recovery boundary

findings.finding: Existing permanent-error page never automatically retried after server authorization becomes valid
findings.correction: Controlled five-minute recovery only visible and near; cooldown/dedup/no hidden requests; genuine validated response activates UI

findings.finding: Copied Portuguese matchers and pre-AVIF image block caused false test failures
findings.correction: Stable Unicode-safe accessible matchers and both AVIF/WebP network blocks; retain original failed harness separately

findings.finding: Authentic Google API authorization/server response not homologated
findings.releaseException: Owner permits future publication with honest unavailable state; not a blocking ZE-11 independent completion criterion; no fake source PASS

findings.finding: A pre-main native anchor intermittently missed its position because module-resolved readiness preceded actual Suspense commit
findings.correction: Stable onReady callback from mounted editorial child; observers/fonts/anchor effects follow actual targets

findings.finding: Footer privacy access moves as deferred editorial content mounts, desktop CLS0.003333; mobile CLS0
findings.decision: Preserve immediate privacy access; below0.1, no score-only optimization loop

limits: Pixel/PSNR diagnostics supplement visible review, not lossless-image claims. Fixture recovery is not real Google authorization. Cold/warm and simulated/observed metrics remain distinct. No secrets or provider review bodies in evidence.
